text: I think you'll love this recipe for Delicious Brown Edge Wafers! It features two large eggs, which are a staple in many of the recipes you've liked in the past. The addition of vanilla is also a great match for your taste, as it's a common ingredient in many of your favorite desserts. The fact that this recipe is quick to make, ready in just 30 minutes, also fits with the cooking time of the recipes you've enjoyed. Give it a try and see what you think!
